ai_summary: BIL Vyapar Limited (formerly Binani Industries Limited) has formally notified stock exchanges of the first meeting of its Committee of Creditors on August 3rd, 2026, explicitly stating the company is "under CIRP" (Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process). This disclosure serves as a significant red flag, indicating the company's severe financial distress and a high risk for investors, as its future solvency and operational continuity are now subject to the insolvency resolution process.
